<p>
Hey, <b>I'm Elias!</b> A self-driven developer based in Argentina who loves turning ideas into real, functional things on the web. I work with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Node.js and Python — but honestly, the tech stack matters less than the problem I'm trying to solve. I've always believed that the best way to learn is to build, break, and rebuild. Whether it's crafting clean frontend interfaces, setting up backend logic, or scripting something to automate a repetitive task, I'm in. Currently expanding my skills and open to whatever the next interesting challenge turns out to be.
